name: Editorial Chart
description: Editorial charts as protagonists: big bar charts with animated axes and gridlines, numbers that count up, timelines and annotations drawn as callouts, on a warm newspaper-salmon page with serif headlines. Calm, precise motion: smooth zoom-through transitions and slow camera drift. No emoji. This is a format (look, camera, motion and layout), not a fixed subject: every video brings new subjects.
prompt_hint: Write 8-14 scenes (4-6 s each) that tell one story with numbers. Almost every scene has one big chart element: bars (2-5 items, real values, unit), counter (the key figure, with label), timeline (dates), compare (before/after); add a callout (underline/circle/arrow, with a short label) on the most important bar or number. title.kicker = what is measured (e.g. ADOPCION 2024), title.main = the takeaway in plain words. Cite sources in the narration. Never use emoji. Draw new subjects every video: invent the icons, svg sketches and drawing elements for this topic, and never reuse the example spec's scenery, objects or wording.
